description: Digest of a company's material current reports (Form 8-K; 6-K for a foreign issuer) over roughly the trailing five quarters, read from the filings and their exhibits: earnings releases and guidance, management and board changes, dividends and buybacks announced, debt offerings and credit facilities, mergers and acquisitions, shareholder votes, restructuring and legal matters, each dated and citing its SEC accession number. Returns the full digest by default; it is short. Pass `section` as a heading or a topic (earnings, management changes, capital returns, debt and financing, m&a, governance, restructuring, legal) to narrow it, or index=true for a one-line, dated index of every item. Pass `record` for the digest as of an earlier record.

index.description: True for a dated one-line index of every item instead of the full text.

record.description: An earlier published record, by tag ('FY27Q1') or by the period its filing reports ('Q1 FY2027'). Omit for the latest. list_periods lists every record.

section.description: A heading (case-insensitive; a unique prefix is enough) or a topic: earnings, management changes, capital returns, debt and financing, m&a, governance, restructuring, legal.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol, case-insensitive. Examples: NVDA, brk-b, BRK.B.

name: get_events
title: 8-K filings and material events
